# WORK-YYYY-MM-DD-NNN — Short task title

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | in_progress / completed / partial / blocked / cancelled (choose one) |
| Recorded | YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM +07:00 (Asia/Bangkok) |
| Work performed | Actual date or date range; identify retrospective entries |
| Contributor | Actual human or agent identity; no invented attribution |
| Related task | Prior work entry, issue or none |
| Git state | Branch, base commit or no commits yet, relevant uncommitted changes |

## Objective

What was requested, why it matters, and the bounded outcome for this iteration.

## Changes and findings

- What actually changed or was learned, with relative links to the affected files.
- Relevant constraints, unsuccessful approaches, partial work or important context
  needed to resume. Mark proposals separately from implemented behavior.

## Verification

| Command/check | Outcome and exit code | Evidence/artifact |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Exact command or concrete inspection | passed / failed / not run / historical; key result | Relative path, source, or explanation |

Record failures as well as successes. State what was not run and why. Label
historical checks with their original date; do not imply they were rerun. Include
input/config/method/graph versions or hashes for data/model/graph work and the
working directory if the command was not run from the repository root.

## Decisions

Link durable rationale in `../decisions.md`, or write `None`. Relative links in this
template assume the completed entry is saved under `docs/work-log/`.

## Open issues and limitations

What remains incomplete, blocked, uncertain or unverified; name any running job
and how to inspect it if work continues across sessions. Include the reason a
task stopped. Write `None` when appropriate; do not leave an ambiguous blank.

## Next step

One concrete next action, relevant files/configuration and an acceptance check.
For completed work, name the next project task or state that no follow-up is needed.

## Corrections

None. If needed later, append a dated correction with evidence or link a new entry;
preserve the original reported outcome.
